jobs.title: Associate, Asset Management (Fixed Term Contract)
jobs.description:
Company & Regional Overview
LaSalle is a global real estate investment manager where exceptional investment talent, deep market and sector expertise, and data-driven intelligence are applied through a disciplined fair-value framework. Enhanced by industry-leading research and sustainability insights, we deliver outperformance that meets investor needs for income, growth, and diversification.

We are the investment division of JLL, and our capabilities are supported by the scale of our global platform and the JLL ecosystem, providing us access to a network of global relationships, powerful analytics, market-leading insights, and cutting-edge technology. As part of JLL, we've been recognized as both a World's Most Ethical and World's Most Admired company.

What drives us most is knowing our decisions improve lives and strengthen communities. Through our Culture of Care, we keep people at the heart of business. We also invest in our own people’s growth through our 'Steer Your Career' strategy, empowering customized career journeys and developing managers into coaches, mentors and leaders.

At LaSalle, your perspective and contributions drive meaningful impact. Build your career with an investment management company committed to clients, communities, and each other.

Position Overview
We are seeking a professional for a 6-9 month contract to develop and execute strategies that maximize the performance of real estate investments and achieve investment strategy goals.

Responsibilities will include:

This position primarily requires responsibility for:
- Financial analysis and modeling of real estate assets

- Underwriting (incl. cash flows, sensitivity analyses, IRR analyses)

- Valuations

- Strategic Planning (Hold/Sell)

- Take lead role in creation and review of financial models. Assume responsibility for the accuracy, quality and consistency of analysis

- Train other team members in financial analysis and modeling
- Assist in asset management of acquired properties assuming increasing levels of responsibility to handle assets independently as experience increases

- Evaluate performance of investments

- Review monthly and annual budgets and reporting

- Negotiate with tenants & 3rd parties as appropriate

- Track compliance with internal and external (e.g. lender) requirements

- Monitor property and property manager performance

- Assist in the review and analysis of legal documents and other materials as part of on-going property oversight.
- Develop and implement disposition strategies to maximize exit value, including vendor selection and oversight

- Coordinate/support production of Investor Reports.

- Providing administrative support to team as needed

- Preparation of closing documentation and filing

- Other assignments as requested

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in finance or related field with 3-5 years of experience

- At least a few years of work experience of Asset Management, Property Management, underwriting for Acquisitions or finance.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Independent, well-organized and good at team playing

- Firm understanding of financial concepts, analysis and modeling

- Experience in real estate experience an added advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Asset Management
jobs.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong.  Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

LaSalle Investment Management (“LaSalle”) is a global real estate investment manager with $89 billion of private and public real estate assets under management and over 900 people in 13 countries.  Our diverse investor base includes public and private pension funds, insurance companies, governments, endowments, and high net worth investors from across the globe.  LaSalle sponsors private custom accounts, private open and closed-end commingled funds, and public real estate securities programs.  As a wholly-owned member of JLL, LaSalle's investment teams also draw on the intelligence and resources of its parent company, providing unique access to market opportunities and key industry leaders.

At LaSalle, we deliver investment performance for a better tomorrow for all our stakeholders. We believe investment performance can be impacted by physical climate hazards as well as sustainability-related market and regulatory changes. We integrate sustainability into our portfolio construction, acquisitions, and asset management activities to maximize value for our clients.

Objective of Role:

LaSalle Investment Management is seeking a full-time Analyst to join its Asset Management team in our Chicago or Baltimore offices. This role will provide exposure to a variety of asset classes including office, industrial, retail, and multifamily property investments, and will span various risk profiles and geographic regions.  Analysts primarily focus on property level analysis for the firm’s direct real estate investments and provide assistance to the team in acquiring, monitoring, and improving the performance of commercial real estate investments.

Accountabilities:
Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:
- Perform complex financial analyses, including Argus valuation models and Excel-based underwriting proformas, cash flow projections and sensitivity analyses

- Perform detailed quarterly financial statement analysis, review of rent rolls, current and future cash flow and forecasting of cash flows through Argus

- Review and analyze potential leases and their financial impact on an investment

- Assist property managers in development of annual operating budgets and quarterly reforecasts

- Provide analytical support to colleagues in the areas of fund operations and asset management

- Assist asset managers in the disposition process

- Oversee compliance of ground leases and mortgages

- Gather and evaluate economic and market data

- Assist with client reporting and presentation preparation, including the presentation of investment memoranda

- to the firm’s Investment Committee

Required Qualifications & Experience:
- BA/BS degree in real estate, finance, accounting, or economics or related field with strong record of academic achievement

- Minimum 1 year of professional experience

- Highly skilled in modeling investments in Excel; Argus experience is a plus

- Knowledge of DCF, NPV and cash flow models

- Strong financial and analytical ability with solid organizational skills and ability to multi-task

- Highly-developed verbal and written communication skills

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

- Proactive thinking with detail-oriented and creative problem-solving approach

- Candidate must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Expected compensation for this position:

100,000.00 – 110,000.00 USD per year
Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.

Location:

On-site –Chicago, IL
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements.  We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. Some of these benefits include:
- 401(k) plan with matching company contributions
- Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Care
- Paid parental leave at 100% of salary
- Paid Time Off and Company Holidays
- Early access to earned wages through Daily Pay

At LaSalle, your perspective and contributions drive meaningful impact. Build your career with an investment management company committed to clients, communities, and each other.

Position Overview

To provide commercial risk management, compliance, regulatory and governance support to the business in Asia Pacific .

Responsibilities

- Assist the Vice President, Legal and Compliance Counsel in day-to-day compliance operations for LaSalle Asia Pacific, with a focus on LaSalle Singapore (CMS-licensed entity) and LaSalle Australia (AFS-licensed entity)

- Maintenance of compliance calendar and register - including MAS and ASIC filings, attestations, periodic reviews, policy review cycles and regulatory submission windows

- Support the drafting, review and periodic updates of compliance policies and procedures

- Monitor MAS and ASIC circulars and regulatory developments and provide relevant updates to the business, as appropriate

- Administer and coordinate the firm’s compliance technology platform – tracking of MAS and ASIC appointed representative obligations, attestations, requests etc.

- Assist in audit, regulatory and licensing matters – including compilation and submission of regulatory returns and filings and responding to ad-hoc and routine regulatory queries and client DDQs, where applicable

- Review of marketing materials in line with regulatory requirements

- Participate and provide support in regional and / or global compliance initiatives and projects

- Conduct AML / KYC processes on investor and counterparties in line with firm’s AML / CTF policy

- Assist with compliance monitoring and testing activities and in the preparation of related reports

- Support compliance onboarding and training

- Support compliance with LaSalle books and records obligations

Requirements

- A bachelor's degree in either legal, accounting, business or finance

- At least 3 years’ relevant experience in the investment management industry – real estate preferred but not necessary

- Highly analytical with good sense of understanding of the investment management industry

- Detail oriented, motivated and willing to learn; able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment

- Commercial attitude and enjoy working in team-driven environment with a collaborative spirit

- Excellent written and oral communication skills; ability to work with colleagues across Asia Pacific and globally

- Comfortable with adopting and using new technology tools, including AI-based tools and AI-assisted workflows

jobs.title: Private Wealth Strategic Partnerships, Associate Vice President /Vice President
jobs.description:
Summary/Team Overview

This position is responsible for supporting the Head of Strategic Partnerships and the SVP of Strategic Partnerships in managing and growing the firm’s private wealth distribution relationships. The Strategic Partnerships Group (SPG) is part of LaSalle’s Private Wealth Group (PWG), which raises capital across wirehouses, regional firms, banks, IBDs and RIA custodians. This position will help assist the SPG team in managing relationships and building partnerships across Tier 1 and Tier 2 client firms, with additional responsibilities for several Tier 2 and Tier 3 firms. The role will educate on Alternative Investments and Private Real Estate, and grow sales for JLL Income Property Trust and JLL Exchange. It will also support additional PWG offerings, including three additional private wealth products currently in development for 2026 - 2027. This role works closely with all areas of PWG, including marketing, sales, due diligence, legal and operations.

Accountabilities/Responsibilities

This position reports to the Head of Strategic Partnerships and will support the team in executing the organizational framework in place to service and grow existing relationships, and will independently manage several Tier 2 and Tier 3 relationships. Specific accountabilities will include:

- Support relationship management for Tier 1 and Tier 2 strategic relationships, and serve as primary relationship manager for several Tier 2 and Tier 3 relationships; support coverage of fintech platform partners (e.g., CAIS, iCapital, Subscribe)
- Be a key resource for each firm’s research and due diligence team, relationship manager, compliance and legal team, operations and external and internal sales team
- Build relationships across the firm and its various departments
- Coordinate activity between appropriate contacts at LaSalle and the selling group firm

​- Support ongoing efforts to stay in front of client firms, find ways to increase sales, get additional products approved and strengthen the overall relationship
- In person and virtual meetings and calls
- Help prepare and deliver quarterly sponsor reviews to current clients that include: firm overview, wholesaler activity, platform availability, sales data, additional capabilities, marketing activities, etc.

- Coordinate and attend industry conferences
- Educate advisors on LaSalle/JLL and real estate
- Promote available product offering(s)

- Provide sales team information on selling group firms and their advisors
- Distribution guide
- Platform and research information
- Recap of conferences
- Best ways to work with advisors at that firm to improve efficiency and effectiveness of sales process
- Weekly territory review calls

- Data analysis and AI-enabled efficiency
- Review client firm data
- Utilize Salesforce reports to understand sales at client firms, target specific advisors or segments for campaigns and conference follow-up, etc.
- Leverage AI tools to streamline reporting, meeting prep and research, helping the team work more efficiently and effectively
- Identify opportunities to apply data analysis and AI to improve SPG processes and client insights

Qualifications/Experience
-   5-7 years of financial services experience, with a focus on National Accounts / Strategic Partnerships or intermediary distribution preferred.
- This role requires working with external clients and understanding how to work effectively with internal resources: marketing, wholesalers, research, asset management, shareholder servicing, technology, etc., to bring the appropriate resource commitment to a given client.
- Demonstrable experience working in teams to deliver successful outcomes.
- Currently holds series 7 and 63 securities licenses.
- Computer proficiency including Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) with a working knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce preferred). Demonstrated ability to use AI tools in a professional context (e.g., research synthesis, meeting preparation, reporting, CRM hygiene) is expected, not just preferred.
- Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in a business-related field and advanced business degree is valued.
- Travel will be required.

What LaSalle Offers:
- A comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being and work-life balance, including the following  (all benefits subject to hired employees meeting requirements for eligibility):

- Health benefits include medical, dental, vision, mental health support and additional ancillary insurance plans.

- Generous paid time-off, including paid company holidays. Additional benefits include paid parental leave short-term and long-term disability, as well as other care/wellness programs.

- Financial wellness is supported through a 401(k) plan with a company match, flexible spending accounts or a health savings account.

US Jobs Only: This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Estimated compensation for this position:

135,000.00 – 150,000.00 USD per year
This range is an estimate and actual compensation may differ. Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.

Location:

On-site –Chicago, IL
Opening Type:

Replacement
